description: Retrieve a single recurring item by ID. Optional date range populates the `matches` object.

end_date.description: End of the range used to populate `matches` (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be provided together with start_date.

recurringId.description: Id of the recurring item to query. Call get_recurring_items first to discover ids.

start_date.description: Start of the range used to populate `matches` (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the current month. Must be provided together with end_date.

name: get_single_recurring_item
